tagline: Intelligent Railway Booking, Digital Travel Pass & Journey Assistance

hero.title: Smarter, Safer, Seamless Railway Journeys
hero.subtitle: Featuring dynamic 10-minute seat locking, intelligent proximity allocation, real-time route weather warnings, and P2P berth exchange.

features.seatLockDesc: Select your favorite berth with a temporary 10-minute hold to complete booking without double-booking contention.
features.weatherDesc: Station-wise precipitation warnings and severe meteorological telemetry for informed journey planning.
features.berthExchangeDesc: Request and accept berth swaps directly with verified fellow travelers on your train and date.
features.digitalPassDesc: Paperless instant QR code pass verifiable by TTE & Station Ticket Inspectors in real time.
